meaning: Verify actual generated factory consumers preserve selected owned-value producer identity and protocol calls, separately from Rule invocation coverage.
scope: Finite base-factory create, reconstruct and Entity transition calls for declared named Entity, Value Object, plain Enum and payload-sum fields, including optional/list/set/inline-sum containment. A named payload-sum field is an owned input, not proof of its internal payload construction; sum-producer internals and other runtime families remain separate.
source_identity: Require registered checked graph, reconciled plan and static boundary with matching full certificate and source manifest. Decode field contracts and bind every named field occurrence to the exact source-derived provider path, export and runtime import occurrence. Do not use a renderer or generated descriptors as an outcome oracle.
witnesses: Use bounded independently evaluated source-valid record witnesses. For every populated named field occurrence, exercise its original provider-owned value and raw, shallow-cloned and foreign-provider values. Preserve every selected factory row; zero owned imports are explicitly inapplicable and unvisited or witness-unavailable whole families stay not_evaluable. No passing prefix on capacity.
expected_calls: From source field declaration order and recursive normalization contracts, predict each actual isOwned and key call, exact provider selector, argument identity path aliases, arity, result and sequence. Optional absence makes no provider call; collection elements normalize and form keys in input order; inline sums normalize and key only their chosen payload. Cached collection/sum keys do not fabricate additional provider calls. Entity key formation uses only identity fields; Value Objects use all fields.
identity_paths: Bind observed call arguments to descriptor-read input identities. Record and payload-sum constructions are distinct objects at each occurrence; repeated plain Enum cases from the same provider may alias. A wrong argument, even when structurally equal, must retain its different path identity. Reject unexpected arguments and malformed observations; never read active observation getters.
native_observer: Compile actual captured generated modules with pinned native TypeScript. Wrap original exported provider methods before loading consumers, in source dependency order; invoke original functions and bracket only the requested lifecycle call. Setup, copy, foreign-provider and output-view calls are outside target trace. Native payload contains recipes, schemas, identities and selected bindings, never expected answers.
completion: Compare complete original native outcomes, formed value keys/views, immutable behavior and full provider traces. Every source-owned runtime import occurrence needs both accepted and rejected ownership witnesses. Counts alone do not establish native success. Keep full boundary coverage denominator and report other runtime edges as not_evaluable.
effects: Private verification only, using owned temporary fixtures and no production services. Independent native-surface and retained execution-custody integration for this protocol remain separate before public integration. Existing Rule, factory and public definitions remain unchanged.
claim_ceiling: Finite instrumented factory-to-owned-value protocol evidence, not whole-project interoperability, uninstrumented equivalence, universal purity, a public passing report, admission or release. Full R08-R18 remains open.
